weaknesses.title: HASMETHOD only accepts literal method names
weaknesses.detail: HASMETHOD s0 m with m="deploy" → LAST_N=0 always. HASMETHOD s0 deploy works. Agents cannot gate on ENV/ARG method without EACH METHOD+EQS walk. SEND prep with dynamic names needs dual path.
weaknesses.repro: LET m="deploy"; HASMETHOD s m → 0; HASMETHOD s deploy → 1
